classification: LOCAL_MODEL IO/transaction design under approved GTC/F15P; no native equivalence or cross-process/filesystem atomicity claim.
frame_domain: Complete accepted candidate of4096 bytes with keyless tail_word0, auxdatae0, encinfo0 and CRC16 residual0. No caller-supplied secret, HMAC fallback or tail RNG state required.
mode: deployed_compat default or etsi_emdf experimental; fixed for programme. A different mode requires EMDF serialization and full fresh F12 trial, never old-frame patching.
per_au_order: validate AU=s-2, exact4096, current length=AU*4096 and fixed frame identity
write at explicit offset in loop; each progress1..remaining, no logical ledger update yet
check final length and readback hash
parent root swap commits staged owner roots plus logical AU count/length/hash ledger
partial_write: Partial progress alone is not failure; zero/error/overrun is fatal. Physical bytes may exceed committed logical length on failure; mark ABANDONED, do not publish partial AU or resume.
crash_boundary: Append/fsync success followed by crash before parent root swap does not authorize recovery from that AU. Abandon entire attempt and full restart, not ledger replay.
finalize_order: verify validated runtime-plan terminal clocks/counts/owner and pending ledger plus exact plan.output_bytes staging length; primary example17395712 is not universal
atomic rename under existing selected final-path precondition
pre_rename_failure: Ledger/length/terminal-fsync failure retires attempt and abandons temp; no new final file from this attempt.
rename_failure: When atomic rename/replace itself fails before namespace change, do not claim DONE; old successful final file if present remains unchanged under filesystem atomic-rename assumption. Abandon temp.

post_rename_parent_fsync_failure.fact: Atomic rename may already have made the new path visible before parent fsync fails. Memory transaction cannot undo filesystem visibility.
post_rename_parent_fsync_failure.required_safe_result: No DONE or successful published receipt; retire attempt and stop this attempt. Record existing DURABLE_OUTPUT_ERROR with finalize/parent-sync phase using existing attempt/status/abandoned/error-phase fields. Do not fabricate rollback of already completed AU ledger.
post_rename_parent_fsync_failure.namespace_policy: Selected F15P final path must not overwrite an existing successful product. This clarification grants no overwrite permission. If a separately allowed generic replace succeeded before parent-sync failure, the old product is not guaranteed to remain.
post_rename_parent_fsync_failure.cleanup: No mandatory quarantine, new marker protocol or automatic recovery system. Do not automatically delete/re-rename/overwrite a visible final path. Cleanup/restart obey existing explicit output policy.
post_rename_parent_fsync_failure.scope: Not a reason to require private authentication or block already-defined pure-domain source transactions.

cleanup: Optional truncate/delete of abandoned temp is cleanup only, never rollback/resume authority. No actual filesystem operation performed by this audit.
keyless_scope: F14K is frame-local CRC checksum over current EMDF, without private authentication state; CRC math/profile compatibility remains governed by approved F14K and separate verification. No certification or universal decoder compatibility claim.
